title: Apples and oranges as disjoint sets
alt: Engraved newspaper-style illustration of two large circular sets side by side: A, packed with line-shaded apples, and O, packed with stipple-shaded oranges. The circles do not overlap, and the headline reads A intersect O equals the empty set.
caption: Apples and oranges as disjoint sets: no element belongs to both, so A ∩ O = ∅. Engraved illustration; fruit counts and sizes are decorative.
data_source: Conceptual set-theory illustration; fruit drawn with fiziko sphere shading on a jittered hex grid with the recorded seed.
